sections.notes: Put-in Odd Fellows (BLM Campground) (Encampment): exact agency facility pin. Take-out Smelter Plant (Town of Riverside) (Encampment): exact agency facility pin. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (2.7 mi); no agency mileage found.
